scope: Core workflow UX audit remediation closeout

baseline.targetManifestPolicy: Immutable checkpoint record; not rewritten during closeout.

commands.detail: 16 parent workflows, 63 persona segments, 52 handoffs, 409 stable steps

results: Authenticated Builder dashboard, proposal, active Build, Notifications, and recovery paths rendered against production-backed data.
Authenticated Admin dashboard, proposal, Build, Draw, Site Visit, onboarding, Contractor, User Management, Settings, and Integration paths rendered.
Submitted Builder proposal mutation leakage was removed and re-verified.
Authenticated proposal, Build, Draw, Site Visit, Contractor, dashboard, and onboarding pages remained document-contained at 390 CSS pixels after repair.
Draw and Site Visit grouped/table mode toggles changed pressed state and rendered mode.
Proposal and Site Visit audited decision gates rejected blank reasons without committing mutations.
Post-fix Draw and Site Visit console passes contained no React errors.

findings.summary: Canonical active-Build milestone summaries now expose distinct budget and draw availability fields and reconciliation warnings instead of contradictory silent states.
Timeline presentation state is excluded from material audit persistence; normalized no-op transitions are suppressed.
evidence: Automated material-transition and no-op regression coverage

findings.summary: Production and demo draw request paths enforce authoritative capacity, idempotency, collision safety, terminal-state rules, and concurrent reservation behavior.
evidence: Automated draw lifecycle and concurrency regression coverage

findings.summary: Builder proposal surfaces omit lender-only decision and draw controls while authorized backoffice surfaces retain them.
tests: Proposal role-authority component and route suites

findings.summary: Builder entry maps organization, membership, projection, and assignment failures to typed recovery states without exposing raw Convex errors.
Attached or invited contractors open through a Builder-scoped detail route with a return path to the originating Build.
Authorized assignment create, update, and reason-governed removal now share one server contract, emit audits and deliveries, and provide sanitized errors.
Attach-and-invite is atomic and produces contractor-recipient handoffs with receiver acknowledgement and Builder return paths.
evidence: Automated atomicity and delivery regression coverage

findings.summary: The global Notifications control opens a recipient-scoped inbox with loading, filtering, dismissal, resolution, focus management, deep links, and stale-link recovery.
tests: Notification inbox component and recipient-delivery backend suites

findings.summary: Production and demo site-visit tokens preserve an immutable organization, Build, milestone, and request provenance tuple and reject tampering or cross-scope use.
Timeline save payloads match server validators and failed saves preserve explicit unsaved state, sanitized feedback, and safe retry behavior.
evidence: Automated failure, rollback, and retry regression coverage

findings.summary: Draw rejection requires a nonblank reason on both client and server and confirms the request, Build, and amount context.
Proposal close and active-Build provisioning are transactional; unavailable records return contextual recovery instead of dead navigation.
Shared Build workspace navigation reflows at target widths, contains horizontal overflow, preserves keyboard focus, and exposes 44px mobile shell controls.
Dashboard rows classify live Builds by activeBuildId and authorized availability, with contextual unavailable-state recovery.
Crew selection, invitation, editing, and removal are separate accessible modes with normalized labels and nonnested controls.
Material audit events remain distinct from per-recipient deliveries; draw, release, site-visit, and contractor workflows create deduplicated outcome-based handoffs.
evidence: Automated delivery deduplication, acknowledgement, and resolution coverage

findings.summary: Principal activation recovery reports typed projection state, responsible actor, support reference, and authorized next action instead of generic denial.
evidence: Automated activation-state and sanitized recovery coverage

findings.summary: Canonical Builder-broker relationship state drives onboarding gating and authenticated workspace confirmation.
Implicit cross-broker transfer is now denied and Principal reads are tenant-scoped, but no transfer command is shipped because platform authority and record-disposition policy remain unvalidated.
evidence: Automated cross-tenant isolation and implicit-transfer rejection coverage
findings.blocker: Product/legal must define the Platform Admin capability, source and destination approvals, WorkOS sequencing, treatment of active Builds/Loans/Budgets/Draws/Evidence, queue rerouting, acknowledgement, and immutable history retention. WF-TEN-003 remains NEEDS_VALIDATION in the workflow manifest.

findings.summary: Staff access changes fail closed and project typed pending, failed, active, and deactivated states with capability delta, effective time, affected-work warning, and recovery.
tests: WorkOS projection, management, RBAC, and protected-access suites
evidence: Automated fail-closed projection and recovery coverage

findings.summary: WorkOS membership acceptance is canonical, confirmation is bound to the authenticated user, duplicate claims are revoked, and lifecycle handoffs are auditable.
evidence: Automated invitation, acceptance, duplicate-claim, and lifecycle coverage

findings.summary: Quick Add uses a contained mobile drawer with isolated modes, safe overlay clearance, focus management, and target-width reflow.
tests: Contractor planning responsive and interaction suites

findings.summary: Production operations queues project proposal, Build, draw, milestone, and site-visit work with escalation and authority boundaries.
tests: Production proposal queue, escalation, and authority suites
evidence: Automated queue projection and authority coverage

findings.summary: Geofence failure retains evidence, records the location attempt and verification state, and routes review rather than discarding the package.
tests: Site-visit backend, model, and UI suites

findings.summary: Lender draw review uses responsive disclosure, authority-safe actions, contained errors, and reachable controls at target widths.
tests: Timeline and funding workspace accessibility suites

findings.summary: Tenant-scoped integration configs execute signed deliveries through pending, delivered, failed, and retry states with redaction and auditable attempts.
tests: Integration configuration, delivery, retry, signing, and redaction suites

findings.summary: Proposal stage navigation compacts without overflow and preserves TanStack search-parameter round trips and keyboard focus.
tests: Proposal route/search and workspace accessibility suites

findings.summary: Three-plan comparison, explicit selection, persisted selected-plan snapshots, and packet-submission gating are integrated across all fixtures and adjacent suites.
tests: Proposal timeline, surface, adapter, and route suites

findings.summary: Milestone-scoped cost entry exposes one authoritative add action, impact preview, milestone switching, and correct mutation payload.
tests: Material planning and timeline worksheet suites
evidence: Proposal and active-Build Materials browser fixture coverage

findings.summary: Budgets are immutable versions with variance, revision request metadata, and lender-admin approval or rejection governance.
evidence: Automated budget-version and decision regression coverage

findings.summary: Calendar export reports feedback and preserves the filtered event scope and durable subscription path.
tests: Calendar workspace export and production calendar suites

findings.summary: Submitted proposal calendar events expose authority-correct read-only/request behavior instead of misleading direct-edit affordances.
tests: Calendar event drawer, adapter, workspace, and production calendar suites

findings.summary: Calendar shells reflow across proposal and Build personas while preserving tab/timeframe search contracts and data-source guards.
tests: Calendar workspace and proposal/build route search-contract suites

findings.summary: Reminder actions are partitioned from milestone/draw mutations and cancellation remains a confirmed auditable soft transition.
tests: Calendar context-menu, event-drawer, workspace, and assistant suites

findings.summary: Multi-day records remain logical ranges while semantic deduplication prevents duplicate keyboard and accessibility-tree entries.
tests: Calendar workspace and agenda semantic suites

findings.summary: New-contractor email validation is explicit, inline, accessible, and consistent across desktop and mobile modes.
Consumed site-visit tokens are terminal, idempotent, and provide safe recovery rather than permitting duplicate submission.
tests: Site-visit token backend, route-model, and UI suites
evidence: Automated consumed-token and duplicate-submit regression coverage

findings.summary: Cost-entry validation rejects invalid amounts with accessible field feedback and preserves dialog state for correction.
tests: Material planning dialog and production proposal validation suites
evidence: Automated invalid-cost and correction-flow regression coverage

remainingRisks.description: Validated cross-brokerage transfer authority and record-disposition policy are still required before implementation. Current code fails closed, prevents implicit transfer, and isolates tenant reads.

Authenticated browser repetition used the supplied Builder and Lender Admin accounts. Contractor, Inspector, Builder Staff, Lender Operations, Platform Admin, and Technical Admin remain deterministic fixture/automated coverage; the live tenant also had no requested draw, and destructive/external submits were intentionally not committed.

The configured typecheck passes. A supplementary root-wide tsc --noEmit remains outside that gate and currently reports 374 strict errors across 100 files. The six workflow files targeted by the final diagnostic follow-up report zero errors under that same check; the remaining legacy and production debt is explicit engineering-quality work.

humanDecisionsRequired.decision: Approve a cross-brokerage transfer policy covering authority, consent, active-work disposition, WorkOS sequencing, queue rerouting, acknowledgement, and immutable audit retention.
